[[File:Marjorie Thompson.jpg|thumb|Marjorie Thompson at the Brown University Commencement 2014]]
'''Marjorie Ellen Thompson''' (January 31, 1954 – September 15, 2014) was an American biologist and musician who served as Associate Dean of Biological Sciences at [[Brown University]].

Thompson received a ScB in biochemistry and a PhD in biology from Brown, in 1974 and 1979 respectively, and was appointed Associate Dean of Biological Sciences in 1983, a position she continued to hold until her death in 2014.<ref name="bdh">{{cite web|url=http://www.browndailyherald.com/2014/09/16/associate-dean-biological-sciences-marjorie-thompson-dies/|title= Associate Dean of Biological Sciences Marjorie Thompson dies |last=Joselow|first=Maxine|date=September 16, 2014|publisher=Brown Daily Herald|accessdate=2 January 2015}}</ref> Her awards as Associate Dean included the [[Barrett Hazeltine]] Senior Class Citation in 1994 and 1996, the Onyx Award in 1998 and the Dean’s Award for Excellence in Undergraduate Teaching and Advising in 2009.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.brownmedicinemagazine.org/blog/marjorie-drucker-thompson-74-phd79-p02-07-09-12-15-16/|title=Marjorie Drucker Thompson|publisher=Brown Medicine|accessdate=2 January 2015}}</ref> Outside of her work as an academic, Thompson also worked as a guitarist and singer-songwriter,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.democratandchronicle.com/story/lifestyle/columnist/spevak/2014/03/04/fleshtones-still-going-strong/5987769/|title=Hot tickets, new shows|last=Spevak|first=Jeff|publisher=Rochester Democrat & Chronicle|accessdate=2 January 2015}}</ref> releasing four albums, playing with [[Jorma Kaukonen]], and appearing on ''[[The Oprah Winfrey Show]]'' as part of an episode about "women who are changing the definition of middle age".<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.browndailyherald.com/2008/02/28/bio-dean-to-appear-in-grand-old-oprah-land/|title=Bio dean to appear in 'grand, old Oprah Land' |last=Walters|first=Kurt|date=February 28, 2008 |publisher=Brown Daily Herald|accessdate=2 January 2015}}</ref>
